sections.SUMMARY: All-thought withdrawn, thought-free tended, face-to-face attained. Infinite-formed welcomed, one-marked entered; imagine-not vowed. Khecarī-streams flow full lakes; dived sky-Lady stirs inert. Sequenced five done trusted as Śiva-I. Cast-counted guru-worded weighed in self accomplishes. Imagined Bhairava-I owns world-modes like fire owns flames, sun shine. One measurer-measured-measure-measured kinded pure-formed, fourteen sky-goers.

rasa.dominant: vīra of face-to-face; vīra of vowed unimagining; vīra of stirred inert; vīra of trusted five-doing; vīra of weighed accomplishment; adbhuta of dreamt owning; adbhuta of fourteen-measured
rasa.sthayibhava: utsāha at withdrawn-attained; utsāha at entered-vow; utsāha at dived-stirred; utsāha at doing-trusted; utsāha at guru-counted; vismaya at imagined-owned; vismaya at measurer-measured
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is exultation: withdrawn, tended, face-to-face. Attaining relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: welcomed, entered, unimagined. Vowing relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: flowed, dived, stirred. Diving relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: done five, trusted Śiva-I. Trusting relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: counted, weighed, accomplished. Weighing relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: dreamt, owned, shone. Imagining relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: one measuring, fourteen measured. Measuring relished.
